items.title: SpaceX Expects to Pass “One Gigawatt a Month” of AI Compute by the End of 2027. That’s Great News for Nvidia
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSpaceX is adding about 500 megawatts of AI compute a month, roughly 220,000 Nvidia GB300 chips, and expects to pass a gigawatt a month by the end of 2027. On Apollo CEO Marc Rowan’s estimate that half a gigawatt’s cost goes to Nvidia, that target means about $300 billion a year headed to Nvidia.

items.title: Apple’s CEO Calls Memory Pricing “Unprecedented.” Its Purchase Obligations Jumped $33 Billion in a Quarter
items.summary: Key TakeawaysApple CEO John Ternus called memory pricing “unprecedented” and said Apple’s manufacturing purchase obligations rose $33 billion from June to September. Memory costs look set to weigh on Apple’s gross margin into fiscal 2027, and its price increases only partly offset them.
